svg.aria-label: IQ-TREE3-GPU: an alignment of eight bacterial genomes becomes a tree; Felsenstein pruning computes conditional likelihoods up the tree; the same calculation runs on CPU and GPU, the GPU finishing first (3.73x median measured speedup); one NNI move reaches the maximum-likelihood tree.
svg.text: The repository's worked example: 8 gut genomes of the genus CAG-269, labelled by host; 3,997 amino-acid sites. One column is followed.
Children before parents, for 2,194 patterns x 4 rate categories. The vectors shown are recomputed here and match IQ-TREE to 1e-4.
Same tree, same arithmetic, same log L. Timing scaled to the measured median speedup; illustrative, not a replay of one run.
IQ-TREE proposes the move; the GPU evaluates it. Both log L are real: LG+G4, branch lengths optimised on each topology.
UFBoot support, 1,000 replicates. GPU and CPU gave the same topology in 182 of 182 paired benchmark runs.
conditional likelihood of node v, from its children a, b
c runs over v's children; P(t) from LG, one per rate category
